footnote_text: The disposition and acquisition rows reflect the same bona fide gift of 29,787 ordinary shares, which was made by the reporting person and his spouse to a trust established for the benefit of members of the reporting person's family, with the trust subsequently contributing the shares to its wholly owned Third Delaware 2011, LLC, and such shares are included in the LLC holdings reported herein. The reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership of any shares held by the trust and LLC, except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
